settings.description: How your order reaches you, and what to do if it is not right.

settings.label: Physical
settings.heading: Mugs, bags and paper goods
settings.text: Packed within two working days and sent tracked. Most orders arrive three to five days later.

settings.label: Digital
settings.heading: Downloads
settings.text: The download link appears as soon as you pay, by email and in your account. Download it as often as you need.

settings.label: Gifts
settings.heading: Sending to someone else
settings.text: Add their address at checkout. Prices never appear on the packing slip.

settings.label: Abroad
settings.heading: Shipping outside the country
settings.text: We ship to most countries. You see the delivery price for yours at checkout, before you pay.

settings.label: Returns
settings.heading: Changed your mind
settings.text: Send anything physical back unused within 30 days for a full refund. Downloads can be refunded within 14 days if you have not opened them.

settings.label: Help
settings.heading: Something went wrong
settings.text: Write with your order number, and a photo if it helps. We will put it right.
